message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO on Technology in Schools
message.email_body: Teaching students how artificial intelligence works in Secondary 2 Programming and AI caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth. We are reaching out to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives you a chance to develop useful content with an education consulting team and discuss a suitable collaboration format, helping your audience apply practical technology in schools. Please reply if a short call this month would suit you.
message.dm: Your video on Secondary 2 Programming and AI caught our attention. Would you be open to discussing an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video with EDXSO?
